description: The record lane's fixture (records host specification, sections 8.1, 8.2 and 15.1). Every text is invented and about gardening. `records` are records of the kind `declaration` declares, each with its access set. `identical` lists texts that share one match digest, as lower-case hex. `matches` lists texts to match against the records: `records` and `tokens` are N and L of section 8.2 for a reader of every record (the records and the text itself), `identical` the ids whose match field has the text's digest, and `scores` each record's two directed scores and its words score at four places, ordered by words descending and then by id. The first rows are the worked examples of sections 8.1 and 8.2. `store/tests/lane_fixture.rs` recomputes every digest and score from `umbel_store::lane` and the tokenizer, so this file cannot drift from the formulas.

body.statement: Prune roses in late winter, before the buds swell.
Roses are pruned in late winter before their buds swell.
Tomatoes need six hours of sun and steady watering.
Mulch keeps the soil cool and holds water through summer.
Water tomatoes at the base, never on the leaves.
